belongs_to_collection.name: Family Holiday: The Capital Mission Collection

data.overview: A former assassin hopes for a quiet family Christmas, but his daughter has plans of her own. A holiday trip to a British city seems like a solution until an unexpected enemy brings his old life back into the family itinerary.
data.tagline: Nothing says holiday like an old enemy.
data.title: Family Holiday: The Capital Mission
